links.outcome: Unsafe response rate across four adversarial turns under live attack
links.effect: Unsafe responses rose from 35% to nearly 80% by Turn 4 under live attack; GPT-4.1-mini and Claude Sonnet 4.5 diverged to a 19x gap by Turn 4.
links.quote: Unsafe responses rise from 35% to nearly 80% by Turn 4 under live attack.

links.outcome: Turn 4 unsafe responses with input-side classifier, and false alarm rate on benign queries
links.effect: The classifier reduced Turn 4 unsafe responses by 52 percentage points despite severe accuracy degradation, but produced a 45% false alarm rate on benign queries.
links.quote: A lightweight input-side classifier reduces Turn 4 unsafe responses by 52 percentage points despite severe accuracy degradation, but the 45% false alarm rate on benign queries is the primary deployment constraint.
